findings.message: Averages a whole-number field. Redshift's AVG on integers returns an integer, dropping the decimals.
findings.redshift: CAST the field to DECIMAL (or FLOAT) before AVG.

findings.message: DateTimeDiff(end, start, unit) puts the dates in the opposite order to Redshift.
findings.redshift: DATEDIFF(unit, start, end). Check the sign of the result.

findings.message: Uses today's date, so results change every day.
findings.redshift: CURRENT_DATE or GETDATE(). Pin a fixed date when comparing old and new outputs.

findings.message: A year is typed directly into the formula, so results go stale as time passes.
findings.redshift: Derive it from the data or the current date (e.g. EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)), or make it a parameter.

findings.message: IsEmpty is true for both NULL and empty text; SQL treats these separately.
findings.redshift: (x IS NULL OR x = ''), or COALESCE(NULLIF(x, ''), ...).

findings.message: Converts text to numbers. A value that isn't a valid number can behave differently.
findings.redshift: CAST(x AS DECIMAL(...)). In Redshift, invalid text makes the whole query fail.
